title: rosa heckeliana subsp. vanheurckiana
intro: Rosa heckeliana subsp. vanheurckiana, commonly known as Rosa rugosa, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rugosa include antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Rosa rugosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
